第1个产品
https://www.smartbyte-switch.com/16-10-100-1000Base-T-PoE-2-1000Base-X-Industrial-PoE-Switch-PG12141554
强调16个PoE口 PoE af/at 240W budget导轨安装适合户外CCTV cabinet solutions
Saga的型号是
STI-21616GP
port Gigabit PoE+ unmanaged industrial switch with 240W budget, redundant power, and DIN-rail mount for outdoor CCTV cabinets.
1. 16-Port PoE/PoE+ with 240W Budget — Power an Entire Camera Site from One Device
All 16 RJ45 ports deliver IEEE802.3af/at compliant PoE/PoE+ up to 30W per port
240W total PoE budget powers a full deployment of IP cameras, access points, or intercoms without external injectors
Built-in PoE watchdog automatically detects and restarts unresponsive PDs (cameras, APs) — eliminates on-site service calls for frozen devices
Ports 1–4 support 250m long-distance transmission mode — extends reach to distant camera positions in large outdoor sites
2. DIN-Rail Mount + IP40 Fanless Housing — Built for Outdoor CCTV Cabinets
Compact 54×115×158mm DIN-rail chassis slots directly into standard outdoor enclosures and roadside control cabinets
Fanless design eliminates dust ingress and moving-part failures — critical for sealed outdoor cabinet deployments
Wide operating temperature -40°C to +75°C covers roadside, rooftop, and industrial perimeter installations year-round
6KV surge protection on power and Ethernet ports + ESD Air-15kV/Contact-8kV guards against lightning strikes common in open-field CCTV deployments
3. Redundant Dual Power Input with Relay Alarm — No Single Point of Power Failure
Dual DC 44-57V redundant inputs with polarity reverse and over-current protection switch seamlessly on supply loss
Onboard relay alarm output (terminal block Pin 5/6) triggers external notification on power failure — integrates with site monitoring systems
MTBF >200,000 hours; CE/FCC/RoHS/UKCA certified — meets infrastructure-grade reliability requirements for transport and public safety networks
Application: Outdoor IP surveillance cabinets, roadside CCTV deployments, perimeter security, transportation monitoring, oil & gas field camera networks.
第2个产品
https://www.smartbyte-switch.com/48-10-100-1000Base-T-4-1G-2-5G-10G-SFP-Layer-3-Managed-Ethernet-Switch-PG12130177
强调端口48口1G和10G上联光口
可支持单/双AC输入，以及1G的RAM，Marvell AC5方案以及512MB的flash
L3功能比如RIP/OSPF/BGP/ECMP/VRRP
Saga的型号是
STC-448XGGM
port Gigabit L3 managed switch with 4×10G SFP+ uplinks, Marvell AC5 platform, 1GB RAM, and flexible AC/DC power options.
1. Enterprise-Grade L3 Routing — RIP, OSPF, BGP4, ECMP, VRRP with 13K Routing Entries
Full dynamic routing suite: RIPv1/v2, OSPFv2, BGP4, IS-IS for complex multi-site and ISP network topologies
ECMP (Equal-Cost Multi-Path) with recursive routing and load balancing maximizes link utilization across redundant uplinks
VRRP provides virtual gateway failover — eliminates single points of failure at the distribution or core layer
IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack with DHCP server/relay, PIM-SM multicast routing, and 13K routing entries for large-scale deployments
2. Marvell AC5 Platform — 1.2GHz CPU, 1GB RAM, 512MB Flash
Marvell AC5 series switch chip and 1.2GHz CPU deliver 336 Gbps switching capacity and 499.9 Mpps forwarding rate — headroom for line-rate L3 routing at full 48-port load
1GB RAM and 512MB flash support large routing tables, extensive logging, and dual-partition firmware upgrades without service interruption
Dual partition management allows in-service OS upgrades with instant rollback — a hardware spec that directly reduces maintenance risk
3. Flexible Power Input — Single AC, Dual AC, or AC+DC — One SKU Fits All Sites
Default single AC 100-240V; optional dual AC 100-240V for full power redundancy; optional AC+DC (36-72V) hybrid for sites with mixed power infrastructure
Three orderable SKUs cover everything from cost-sensitive SMB deployments to carrier-grade redundant power requirements without hardware redesign
4× 1G/2.5G/10G SFP+ auto-negotiation uplinks scale backhaul bandwidth to aggregation or WAN without module swaps — future-proof at purchase
Application: SMB and mid-enterprise core/distribution layer, ISP edge, multi-site VoIP and video streaming, campus network aggregation, hybrid AC/DC power environments.
第3个产品
https://hohunet.com/product/s7548n-8z-ei-plus-data-center-switch48-x-25g-sfp288x100g-qsfp28-dual-power-supply-module-4-hot-swappable-intelligent-fan-module/
强调端口48口25G和8个100G上联光口
强掉1+1 热插拔电源和4个智能风扇模块
强调数据中心的使用场景和这些重要功能MACsec  EVPN  Vxlan	MPLS	Stacking	MLAG
Saga的型号是
STH-8C48DX-HSI
Data center L3 switch with 48×25G SFP28 and 8×100G uplinks, 1+1 hot-swap PSU, and 4 smart fan modules.
1. High-Density 25G Access + 100G Uplinks — Built for Data Center Spine-Leaf
48× 25G SFP28 downlinks connect directly to servers, storage arrays, and hyperconverged nodes at wire speed
8× 100G QSFP28 uplinks deliver non-blocking backhaul to spine layer at 4 Tbps bidirectional switching capacity and 1.82 Bpps forwarding rate
Purpose-built for data center leaf role: high server-port density, low latency, and enough uplink bandwidth to avoid oversubscription at scale
Supports PFC/DCBX/ECN for lossless Ethernet — essential for NVMe-oF, RoCE, and storage-heavy HCI workloads
2. 1+1 Hot-Swap Power Modules + 4 Intelligent Hot-Swap Fan Modules
Two 800W CRPS hot-swappable power supplies operate in active-active redundancy — replace a failed PSU under full traffic without touching the network
Four independently hot-swappable intelligent fan modules (front-to-back airflow) adapt cooling speed dynamically to real-time thermal load
Both PSU and fan replacements require zero downtime — critical for data centers running 24/7 SLA-bound workloads
MTBF ≥90,000 hours with hardware watchdog and BHM process monitoring for continuous autonomous operation
3. Full Data Center Feature Stack — MACsec, EVPN, VXLAN, MPLS, MLAG, Stacking
VXLAN with BGP EVPN and distributed gateway enables multi-tenant overlay networks and seamless cross-DC interconnect for cloud and HCI environments
MLAG Active-Active builds device-grade link redundancy across two switches — eliminates single points of failure at the leaf layer without stacking reboots
MACsec (802.1AE) AES-CMAC encrypts switch-to-switch traffic end-to-end — meets zero-trust security requirements in shared and colocation DC environments
MPLS (LDP, L2VPN/VPWS/VPLS, L3VPN) via MA license extends the same switch into carrier metro and IPRan transport roles; stacking (up to 8 units) via ST license for campus-to-DC unified fabric
Application: Data center leaf layer, hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), cloud multi-tenant overlay networks, carrier IPRan/metro aggregation, enterprise core with DC interconnect.
